delivery.en: USPS delivers to the address, but island transit is slower; a surprise USPS call is not official
delivery.zh: USPS 可送到住址，但較美國本土慢；突然打來的 USPS 電話不是投遞通知

readback.en: After 340, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero or oh; US dollars; 12-hour a.m./p.m.; month first
readback.zh: 340 區碼後照 3-3-4 唸，0 可唸 zero 或 oh；美元；12 時制；先月後日

fraud.en: Unsolicited official-sounding calls aimed at seniors, as the VIPD has warned, are scams
fraud.zh: 向長者打來、聽起來像官方的陌生電話，維京群島警方已警示，應當成詐騙

habits.en: US English with some Caribbean colour. Month first, zip codes, US dollars. Good afternoon is common.
habits.zh: 美式英語為主，帶一點加勒比色彩。日期先月後日，有 zip code，用美元。

stall_local.en: USPS tracking has sat still for days, which can happen on island routes, and the bank app is stuck.
stall_local.zh: USPS 查件好幾天沒動，島嶼航線有時會這樣，而且銀行 App 刷新不了。

reason.zh: 英式說法；美屬維京群島用 zip code
英式說法在這裡不如 cell 自然，雖也聽得懂
英式住宅用語，當地較常說 apartment 或 house

talk_style_diff.en: Closer to the US parent than the British-Caribbean islands, but a little more formal with elders. Do not invent a specific VIPD pitch; just refuse official-sounding pressure for money or codes.
talk_style_diff.zh: 比英式加勒比島更接近美國母區，但對長輩可稍正式。不要編造警方警示裡的具體話術，只需拒絕要錢或要驗證碼的官方腔來電。

uncertain: VIPD 警示標題確認針對長者的電話詐騙，此次未能打開全文核對具體話術，故 fraud 寫得較概括。
cell 與 mobile 在島上的使用比例沒有調查。
